description: This file is an implementation of the CustomerFacade interface, providing various customer-related operations such as registration, address management, cart merging, and authentication within the e-commerce platform. It acts as an abstraction layer between controllers and service layer, utilizing multiple services and populators to handle customer data.

classes.name: CustomerFacadeImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CustomerFacade, providing customer operations such as registration, address handling, cart management, and authentication.

methods.name: getCustomerDataByUserName
methods.description: Fetches customer data by username and store, returning a CustomerEntity if found.

methods.name: mergeCart
methods.description: Merges the shopping cart associated with a customer and session, returning shopping cart data.

methods.name: getCustomerByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves customer entity based on username and store.

methods.name: checkIfUserExists
methods.description: Checks if a user with the given username exists in the specified store.

methods.name: registerCustomer
methods.description: Registers a new customer based on provided customer data.

methods.name: getCustomerModel
methods.description: Constructs a Customer model from persisted customer data and populates it.

methods.name: customerEntityPoulator
methods.description: Converts a Customer model into a CustomerEntity.

methods.name: setCustomerModelDefaultProperties
methods.description: Sets default properties for a Customer, including generating username and password if absent and assigning default groups.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs authentication for a customer using Spring Security.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves address (billing or delivery) for a customer.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates the address details for a customer.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves a readable customer data object by customer ID.

methods.name: populateCustomerModel
methods.description: Populates a customer model from a PersistableCustomer object.
